discription: A basic pulse wave synth with a detuned second oscillator and a low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Pulse.ar(freq) * 0.5 + Pulse.ar(freq * 1.005) * 0.5; sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); Out.ar(out, (sig * amp * env) ! 2);}
